topline: PR44 should make the rendered LLM context visibly inspectable in the canvas, not merely serialized into the generated data block.
base_assumption: PR43 introduced render_context_packet and rendered_context_packet payload fields. PR44 depends on that work.

problem_statement.observed_local_failure: After generating the canvas locally, the visible canvas did not show the constructed LLM context. The context existed in the payload, but the canvas shell did not render it.
problem_statement.root_cause: The Step 2D emitter patches only the generated data block between markers. It does not create or update the React/TSX UI outside those markers. Therefore a canvas shell must explicitly render rendered_context_packet.
problem_statement.required_fix: Add or update a repo-local canvas template/shell that renders rendered_context_packet in an expandable details/accordion section for each question card or row.

in_scope: Add a repo-local C1S4 canvas TSX template with generated data markers.
Render benchmark summary, mode summary, guardrails, question cards, and rendered LLM context.
For each question card, add an expandable details section labeled Rendered LLM Context.
Render section summaries, full rendered_text, individual sections, and provenance map from rendered_context_packet.
Update tests to prove the template references rendered_context_packet and includes details/accordion UI.
Document how to copy/use the template with step2d_expected_context_canvas_emit.
out_of_scope: Changing renderer semantics unless needed to support display.

files_added_or_expected.purpose: Repo-local Cursor canvas shell/template that actually renders rendered_context_packet with expandable details UI.
Machine-readable handoff and review contract for PR44.

generated_data_block.reason: The existing emitter replaces only this block. The rest of the template must remain stable UI code.

must_render: Rendered LLM Context expandable section per question
visible_ui.preferred_ui_primitive: HTML <details>/<summary> because it is simple, deterministic, and does not require extra dependencies.

acceptance_criteria: A repo-local canvas template exists and can be copied or passed to --canvas-tsx.
The template contains the generated data block markers used by the emitter.
The template renders Rendered LLM Context in an expandable details block for every question card.
The details block displays rendered_context_packet.rendered_text or the sectioned packet content.
The details block displays section summary counts: refs/items, chars, estimated tokens.
The details block displays individual sections such as Known Gaps and Safety Constraints, Support / Adaptation Context, and Prior Campaign Memory.
The details block displays a provenance map with ref, rendered section, source, candidate/admitted rank, and admission reason.
Q1 rendered prior memory is visible in the canvas when expanded.
Q3 known gaps are visible in the canvas when expanded.
Q5 support/adaptation context is visible in the canvas when expanded.
No retrieval/admission behavior changes are introduced.
No oracle/eval-only material is added to the rendered UI.

tests_to_add_or_update.intent: Add a test that reads the repo-local canvas template and asserts it contains generated data markers, details/summary, Rendered LLM Context, and references rendered_context_packet fields.
Keep existing payload tests proving rendered_context_packet is attached to rows/cards.

manual_local_commands: grep -n "Rendered LLM Context\|rendered_context_packet\|Full rendered packet text" /tmp/c1s4-expected-context-benchmark.canvas.tsx

review_checklist.topline_expected: Approved when template exists, tests prove UI references rendered_context_packet, and generated local canvas visibly renders context.
blockers: Template exists but only stores generated data and does not render rendered_context_packet.
Template uses rendered_context_packet only as raw JSON with no readable sections or provenance.
Tests only assert payload data exists and do not assert UI template references rendered context fields.

report_back_format.topline: Approved | Needs revision | Blocked | Approved with caveat
